context_sent.VERTICAL_LENS:
## Vertical: SaaS

This module governs prompt generation for SaaS brands: companies selling software as a subscription service to individuals, teams, or enterprises. This includes productivity tools, design tools, analytics platforms, developer tools, marketing software, and all other software-as-a-service categories.



## What counts as ONE decision in SaaS

INTERCHANGEABLE — different words for one buying question, group them:
the several names one category goes by (the buyer's phrasing, the vendor's phrasing, the acronym, the marketing coinage); the generic noun — software, tool, platform, app, system, solution; two words for ONE role that are the same buyer ("SEO lead" / "head of SEO"); the task stated as a workflow ("how do I [task]") beside the same task stated as a category ("[category] tool"); plan, tier or edition names when the question is which one to pick; and where the buyer is looking (a review site, a marketplace, a directory) beside the plain question.

SaaS duplicates hide in vocabulary rather than in variants: one capability arrives as a workflow question from a keyword, as a plain-English complaint from a forum, and as a vendor's feature clause. Those three are one decision.

DIFFERENT OFFERINGS — never group across these:
the buyer's INDUSTRY or company type ("[category] for healthcare", "[category] for B2B SaaS"), which names a different buyer, not a different word for one — see the base prompt's buyer-segment rule; a NAMED third-party platform, model or channel the question is about, which asks about that platform's coverage; a required integration with a NAMED system; a compliance, residency or security requirement (a certification, where data is stored, single sign-on); a deployment model (self-hosted against hosted, on-premise against cloud); a seat, volume, or scale limit; a budget ceiling or a free-tier / open-source requirement; two capabilities a buyer would license or trial separately, however adjacent the wording; and building it in-house against buying it.
